video_title: Cavs Shootaround | Jarrett Allen Media Availability | 11.23.2026

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the 'Yes We Can' message from Barack Obama
quotes.excerpt: Yes we can, yes we can overcome anything, yes we can go for it and march through anything
quotes.quote: His 'Yes we can' quote, I define them as, you know, yes we can, yes we can overcome anything, yes we can go for it and march through anything that adversity that's in our way. That's just what I know Obama's message to be.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen on the Obama message of Yes We Can: It means yes we can overcome anything and march through any adversity in our way.

structured.context: Jarrett Allen discusses the meaning of Barack Obama's message during a media availability session.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on overcoming adversity as a team
quotes.excerpt: When you see something that tough to overcome as a team and have it face forward
quotes.quote: When you see something that tough to overcome as a team and have it face forward in front of you, it translates to everything in life. We're facing adversity every single day. There's stuff that we think we can't overcome, but I'm looking at somebody like him overcome a barrier like that, we can do anything.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says the team is using the concept of overcoming barriers to handle daily adversity: We are facing adversity every single day and we can do anything.

structured.context: Jarrett Allen speaks about the team's approach to overcoming adversity.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on building a stable foundation for the team
quotes.excerpt: I am a firm believer you have to build a foundation before you build a house
quotes.quote: I am a firm believer you have to build a foundation before you build a house. If you have a rocky foundation, the house won't be stable. What we're doing with basketball is making sure that our foundation is stable, our principles are stable, who we are as a team is stable before we have other building blocks to make the house.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen on the Cavs current focus: You have to build a foundation before you build a house. If you have a rocky foundation the house won't be stable.

structured.context: Jarrett Allen explains his philosophy on building a stable foundation for the team.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the team's current defensive focus
quotes.excerpt: Protecting the rim for sure, getting to the paint and making sure that our offense runs smooth
quotes.quote: Protecting the rim for sure, getting to the paint and making sure that our offense runs smooth and we're going in transition and making sure that we're rock solid on defense.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says the Cavs defensive focus remains on protecting the rim and the paint to ensure the offense runs smooth.

structured.context: Jarrett Allen outlines the current defensive focus for the Cleveland Cavaliers.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Donovan Mitchell's call for a team change
quotes.excerpt: Donovan has put down and said it's time for a change. It's time to go forward
quotes.quote: We were a little shaky at the beginning, we were trying to figure ourselves out, but Donovan has put down and said it's time for a change. It's time to, like Obama says, it's time to change, but it's time for change and it's time to go forward and redefine ourselves.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says Donovan Mitchell called for a change after a shaky start: It is time for change and it is time to go forward and redefine ourselves.

structured.context: Jarrett Allen reacts to Donovan Mitchell calling for a change in the team's approach.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the defensive impact of Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen
quotes.excerpt: They're defenders that will guard one through five with the tenacity that any team is looking for
quotes.quote: They're defenders that will guard one through five with the tenacity that any team is looking for in a player. Especially us, that's what we need on the defensive end. They try to rile teams up and make sure they make mistakes.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen on the defensive tenacity of the Cavs frontcourt: They are defenders that will guard one through five with the tenacity that any team is looking for.

structured.context: Jarrett Allen discusses the defensive impact of himself and Evan Mobley.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the impact of bench players
quotes.excerpt: I think they push the pace for us. I think they show us a new way of basketball
quotes.quote: I think they push the pace for us. I think they show us a new way of basketball, making sure that we get up and down the floor, making sure that we're not thinking about what play we're running too much, just go down the back, just make sure everybody touches the ball.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen on the impact of the bench: I think they push the pace for us and show us a new way of basketball by making sure everybody touches the ball.

structured.context: Jarrett Allen comments on the energy and pace brought by the bench players.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on returning to defensive principles
quotes.excerpt: I think we're going back to what made us great last year
quotes.quote: I think we're still making our way towards it. I think last year we were a protect the rim team, and you can hear us preaching it all now, protect the rim, protect the rim, protect the paint. I think we're going back to what made us great last year.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says the Cavs are returning to their identity: We are going back to what made us great last year and preaching protect the rim and protect the paint.

structured.context: Jarrett Allen discusses the team's effort to return to their defensive principles from the previous season.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the need for better team communication
quotes.excerpt: I think we're still learning each other's habits like with Evan on the floor
quotes.quote: I think we're still learning each other's habits like with Evan on the floor, he's a great defender and we want to work around him. So we're trying to learn how to play with each other. Evan has been out a time, I've been out a time, Jaylen has been out a time. We've had a lot of different lineups on the defensive end that we're still trying to figure out.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen admits the Cavs are still learning defensive habits due to injuries: We have had a lot of different lineups on the defensive end that we are still trying to figure out.

structured.context: Jarrett Allen explains that the team is still learning defensive chemistry due to various players missing time.
